lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: wait. first slurp. WAIT. this is it. this is THE stall. i've chased this bowl all summer and you walked us straight to it

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: and it cost coins. the trip fund and i are both a little emotional

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: no butter, no milk, happy stomach, and liam is crying into his noodles. best market night ever!!

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: I didn't need to ask. Peanut in the sauce, peanuts crushed over the top. My question has a very short answer here. I'll be by the exit.

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: and it's not even the stall. i'd have known. cyrus's safe bowl first, my stall second

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: i'm carrying cyrus's jacket out of here and i'm literally leaving this cart

lines.speaker: cyrus
lines.text: No sauce, nothing on top that I could see. Then the cook answered the rest of my question: every bowl starts with peanut oil from that tin, straight into the wok. That counts.

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: WAIT. it looked so safe!! nobody order. any peanut, any form, we walk

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: it's not the stall anyway. the stall would never do this to us

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: delicious. but i had to break a bill. i warned you i'd be dramatic, so: this is me being dramatic

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: good bowl. not THE bowl though. maya, the coins for the next one are on me

lines.speaker: roxy
lines.text: so good. then the cook told me what makes the broth so silky. it's dairy. of course it's dairy. my stomach and i are not speaking

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: my tipster warned me and i still walked us into a creamy one. sorry roxy. and no first-slurp moment either, so the stall's still out there

lines.speaker: brooke
lines.text: tasty, but every bowl here is glossy with oil. grandma's going to ask about my greens tomorrow and i'm going to have to confess

lines.speaker: liam
lines.text: not my stall either. the one in my head doesn't drip. brooke, you pick the next cart on the hunt
